details: Scan psutil processes in a single pass looking for priority executable, caching PID to avoid repeated scans

optimization: Consolidated Riot & League process scan pass
details: Instead of LCUClient and RiotClientAPI scanning the active process list independently, they now fetch information from client_detector.py which runs a single pass and caches it with a 2-second TTL.

Ported the CustomTkinter UI to PySide6 QMainWindow. Transitioned the old main app to a headless background service coordinator to eliminate redundant Tkinter widget overhead. Added smooth page fade opacity transitions, collapsible sidebars, and thread-safe EventBus status badges.
Optimized grid redraws by filtering and sorting in-memory datasets before binding widgets, and disabled drag reordering when layouts are locked under sorting filters.

optimization: Lazy page loading and thread pool tasks
details: Speeds up initial layout draw and cuts background thread footprint by using QThreadPool/QRunnable to run matchmaking calls and lazy-instantiating subpages on first switch. Handles instantiation crashes cleanly using centralized error QWidget boundaries.
